import sys, json, time, itertools, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from validate import validate
from adaptive2 import run_one

def scenario(name, links, parts, dem, period, env):
    n=max(max(u,v) for u,v,_ in links)+1
    cmds=[{"op":"load","n":n,"links":[[u,v,c] for u,v,c in links],"bookings":[]}]
    for i,(p,d) in enumerate(zip(parts,dem)):
        cmds.append({"op":"prepare","id":f"p{i}","owner":"o","window":[0,period*10],"period":period,
                     "participants":[[v,d] for v in p],"envelope":env,"rev":i})
    return cmds

links=[(0,1,2),(1,3,1),(3,2,2),(2,0,1)]
cmds=scenario("cycle4", links, [[0,1,2,3]], [1], 1, [[0,1],[1,1],[2,1],[3,1]])
t0=time.time(); reps=run_one(cmds); dt=time.time()-t0
problems=[]; validate(cmds,reps,problems)
print("cycle4:", json.dumps(reps[-1])[:200], f"{dt:.2f}s", problems)
